name: Vineyard City Church
out_of_scope_reason: Appears to have closed. The church's website domain vineyardcitychurch.com no longer resolves in DNS, no service times, staff or sermon media are published anywhere current, and Yelp lists the congregation as CLOSED as of February 2026. Its former meeting address, 3150 E Fort Lowell Rd, is now occupied by Connections Vineyard Church.

summary: Marked out of scope: the congregation appears to have closed and publishes no sermons.
notes: 2026-09-10 fact pass. Set in_scope false rather than deleting, so nobody repeats this. Evidence for closure: (1) vineyardcitychurch.com does not resolve at all - curl returns 'Could not resolve host', so the seeded website URL is dead and was removed from the record; (2) Yelp's listing for Vineyard City Church at 3150 E Fort Lowell is flagged CLOSED, last updated February 2026; (3) that same address, 3150 E Fort Lowell Rd, Tucson AZ 85716, is now Connections Vineyard Church, a separate Vineyard congregation founded in 1999; (4) no current service times, staff list or sermon archive exists on any church-controlled page. I found no announcement of a merger, so 'closed' is inferred from the above rather than stated by the church - if someone can reach Vineyard USA or Connections Vineyard and get a definitive answer, update this. The only pastor name ever found is Gary Stokes, described as Senior Pastor in a Vineyard USA article dated 2016-03-01; he is left out of pastors[] because there is no evidence he is currently preaching anywhere, and this record makes no claim about him. The address field now records the former meeting location instead of the old PO Box placeholder; geocode is deliberately left 'missing' and the record is excluded from the map anyway. Keep this distinct from Vineyard Christian Community (625 N 2nd Ave) and Connections Vineyard Church.
